# Whether any other gate asks for something a ticket cannot say does not apply

All six templates read against their gates. Every field that a gate requires non-empty:

| Stage | Required field | Can a non-code ticket answer it |
|---|---|---|
| clarify | acceptance, decisions | yes, every ticket has both |
| solution | changes, alternatives, risks, rollback, tenant_tables | yes; a policy ticket changes documents, considered other options, carries risks, can be reverted, and writes "none" for tables |
| solution | **tests_first** | **no** |
| tdd | slices | not asked: non-code mode uses its own template, which has no slices |
| review | acceptance_evidence | yes |
| deliver | limits | yes |

`tests_first` is the only one, and the reason is the same one this ticket is about: it is the only
field whose answer depends on a declaration that is made after it is asked for. `slices` has the same
shape and is already solved, by the non-code template that replaces the tdd one entirely; solution has
no such split and does not need one, because one field out of eleven does not justify a second
template to maintain.

So the fix is where the ticket said it was, and nothing else is hiding behind it.
